items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: I'm sure Lester Lewis, Hanson Will Talbidge is dead. He's dead.

ctx.x: During the war you couldn't get the aluminum anymore. Yeah. Sometimes they had steel blanks, but sometimes glass. And that glass thing just broke on us.

Yeah, I had some other ones, but they all got broke. That one, that's why I was trying to get that one secured, so I would have something to remember. Yeah. But I'm sure Albert Boibank had some of them, but everybody mostly recorded what they wanted on the record to keep. Yeah. Yeah, and I'm sure Lester Lewis, Hanson Will Talbidge is dead. He's dead. I guess his wife may have, but I don't know. Well, look.
You know where his wife lives? He had that pressing plant I know up on Rambord Street. Did he live in that section? I wonder, do you know where she would be?
